items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Bert Cobb on bass. That's all I think. Ten of us. ... They called them the Dixie Syncopators.

ctx.x: King Oliver, George Feely, Paul Barberin, Bert Cobb on bass. That's all I think. Ten of us. What kind of a band was it? We were playing shows and then playing Dixie Lamb music. They called them the Dixie Lamb music. They called them the Dixie Syncopators. We saw those.
Were there arrangers for that band?
